title: Make Grid
summary: Return a grid of rows lists, each holding cols copies of fill. Every row must be its own list: changing one row must not change another.
hints: Build one row with cols items, then add it to the grid rows times. Check what that adds: the same list each time, or a new one?
Create a fresh row inside the loop, so each pass makes a new list.
Shortcuts that repeat a list (repeating it with *, filling an array with one value) repeat the reference, not the contents.
